source.file: references/shorts_ref/the magic disappears when he opens his mouth🍅  #art   #procreate   #crush   #shorts   #fyp.mp4

method: LK forward/back checked contours; RANSAC partial affine; fixed caption excluded; post-entry6 to pre-departure7 frames. This measures net held-art transform, not physical camera ownership or original drawing cadence.
limits: Sparse paper/vignette may leave too few corners
Face/hair/hand edits and dissolves break rigid correspondence
A transformed single artwork layer is indistinguishable from camera motion in a mixed export
Caption remains fixed and is intentionally excluded
Partial affine assumes uniform scale+translation+rotation; perspective, masks and blur need direct frame inspection

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Whole drawing gently pulls smaller/upward, then briefly grows again immediately before f49. Shirt/hair/eye linework stays coherent. The opening is readable from f0, without an entrance wipe.
layouts.observedInternalAction: No independent hand/head/eye change established in inspected samples; facial blush and shut-eye expression are held.
layouts.transferRecipe: Use a finite pull then a short anticipation push. The last-frame push prepares the attention cut rather than a perpetual breathing loop.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Small ongoing push/downward move, then a sharper final enlargement at f79. All group lines move together.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Pointing hand, mouth and hair are held drawings in inspected frames; the gesture is conveyed by the pose and camera, not visible finger cycles.
layouts.transferRecipe: Push over the conversation thought; reserve a selected quick focal enlargement for a musical/attention accent.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: f80..approximately f114 is a substantially held portrait; from f116..f123 the art accelerates left with a blurred departure. Fixed caption and vignette do not leave.
layouts.observedInternalAction: No clear internal acting change detected before departure; the attractive expression gets a quiet readable interval.
layouts.transferRecipe: Allow a quiet held beauty face, then a purposeful directional exit. Do not label every hold as poor retention.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Incoming group enters from the right f124..f130 following the departing leftward art. It then continues a shallow left drift/pull; affine fit has about−2.35° roll in f130..f149, treated as an estimate rather than proof of a physical camera.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Faceless extra and cap/backpack contours retain their relationship; no automatic walking/contact is shown.
layouts.transferRecipe: Maintain sweep direction across old/new drawings; continue a mild finite camera move after the arrival instead of stopping at six frames.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: New close drawing at f156; slow push/downward follow across the held phase (~4.4% scale increase f162..f195).
layouts.observedInternalAction: Hand, backpack straps, cap and talking expression remain stable in inspected samples.
layouts.transferRecipe: Close-detail reveal followed by a slow push. Props must remain in the same transform as the held body.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Strong close→miniature contrast at f202. This simplified drawing itself gently pulls smaller (~9% f208..f231) with modest downward drift.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Small smile/head/hair are held; the change from detailed crush art to a miniature reaction carries the thought.
layouts.transferRecipe: Use an actual simplified reaction drawing plus measured scale contrast; the camera path should reinforce the emotional withdrawal.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: A pose cut at f238 keeps the miniature scale family. Only a shallow drift is visible (~5.4px right,3.5px down from f244..f274,360-wide source).
layouts.observedInternalAction: Hair-covered face and shoulder drawing are held. The view/pose change supplies the feeling, with tiny travel keeping spatial continuity.
layouts.transferRecipe: Use a restrained finite move here; avoid flooding this quiet beat with effects.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Large miniature→close jump at f281, followed by an ongoing mild push/downward movement (~4.5% scale and12px central shift f287..f327).
layouts.observedInternalAction: The hand stays at the mouth; hair, sleeve and cheek hatching remain coherent. No hand separation or repeated gesture entry is visible.
layouts.transferRecipe: A hand contact close should share head/contact motion; camera can develop the embarrassment while the grip/art stays stable.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: At f334, large close switches to small tilted simplified head. Over the finite27-frame interval, orientation flips/rotates and faint displaced copies alternate. A single rigid affine fit fails some samples.
layouts.observedInternalAction: This is the clearest finite local performance/effect passage: a small illustrated shake with mirrored/oriented cards and ghost trail, rather than ordinary gentle limb animation.
layouts.transferRecipe: Use one short semantic shake/recoil phrase at the embarrassment peak. Do not repeat it as a background idle everywhere.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Clean cut at f361; foreground body/crowd slowly enlarges (~7% f367..f388) and later edges spread outward. Pale background figures remain intentionally subordinate.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Expression is held. Pale extra outlines are not sufficient evidence of an animated dissolve; direct join samples show an abrupt new composition.
layouts.transferRecipe: Group reveal with a finite push centered on the readable face; extras stay less prominent.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Cut at f395, slight steady push/right/down shift (~1.6% and9px x overf401..f428). Small fitted roll≈0.5°, near the limit of obvious visual notice.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Half-lidded eyes/mouth stay essentially fixed; eye attitude does the comic work.
layouts.transferRecipe: A low-amplitude drift can keep a held reaction readable; do not count blinks alone as meaningful performance.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Full-body contrast at f435. Group pulls smaller (~4.4% f441..f464); aroundf466..f470 the left cap wearer slides out left while the right figure stays, with a faint trail.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Walking is suggested by separately drawn stance art, not established as a continuous foot/contact cycle. The selective character departure differs from a whole-screen pan.
layouts.transferRecipe: Use actual grounded held stance art. An isolated figure exit can carry the thought, but do not fake walking by floating the root.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Cut at f471. Short progressive push (~2.6% f477..f509); final framing relaxes slightly beforef516.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Eye/mouth/sweat drawing stays coherent. No reliably separate lip animation established.
layouts.transferRecipe: Let camera gently approach a held uncomfortable expression; tiny authored eye/head responses are an adaptation, not a claim about this source.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Cut at f516, slow pull/up drift (~1.8% scale decrease f522..f544).
layouts.observedInternalAction: Cheek/hand contact, tired face and shirt drawing hold in samples.
layouts.transferRecipe: Use a finite pull/settling camera thought plus one contact-preserving head/eyeline response.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Immediate pose/ink burst cut atf551. Slow pull/up shift (~2.6% shrink and10.6px up f557..f585), then a short end enlargement atf591.
layouts.observedInternalAction: Startled limbs, spiky marks and greeting bubble form one held illustrated event composition. This is not evidence of an audible shout.
layouts.transferRecipe: Give the arrival a readable semantic reaction; let its finite camera phrase continue under the music and resolve before payoff.

layouts.observedCameraOrArtTransform: Cut atf592. Both halves and split stroke progressively push (~4.3% f598..f620), keeping the caption fixed.
layouts.observedInternalAction: The contrasting faces and hand gestures are held. The split itself establishes the final meaning.
layouts.transferRecipe: A final gentle push can keep the ending alive; the payoff must remain legible and differ from the opening.

joins.observations: f41..48 opening drawing grows before f49; f49 is a complete new group composition. No wipe/flash.
f79 group has enlarged; f80 replaces it with a distinct face drawing, readable immediately. No ghost trail across this cut.
f116 still readable; f119/121 departing portrait shifts left with blur; f123 only its far-left sliver remains; f124 new group begins at right; f129/132 arrives and resolves. Caption remains fixed.
f155 preceding cap group has a brief blur/scale change; f156 switches to a close reverse cap drawing; f159/164 remains coherent.
f201 detailed cap/backpack close; f202 tiny happy protagonist replaces it. The scale/detail contrast is part of the thought.
f237 happy mini; f238 hair-covered/head-down mini. Clean drawing swap at comparable small scale.
f280 tiny head-down; f281 hand-to-mouth close appears whole. No two-body overlap.
f333 large embarrassed portrait; f334 tilted mini. Following frames alternate rotated/mirrored head cards with faint displaced trails.
f360 mini head; f361 crowd context composition. Pale extras are a held design choice, not proof of a gradual dissolve.
f394 crowd composition; f395 close bored woman. Immediate new drawing, then small drift.
f434 close half-lidded face; f435 two full stances, separated spatially. Clear size/context contrast.
f466 left cap figure becomes faint/displaced; f468..470 leaves left while other person remains; f471 reverse female close replaces stage.
f515 reverse smiling close; f516 nervous front torso/contact pose. Clean cut.
f550 held nervous pose; f551 startled illustration and HEY burst land together. Printed speech does not confirm recorded dialogue.
f591 greeting reaction enlarges briefly; f592 split illustration replaces it; f595..600 progressively enlarges. No outro.
